Abhorrent, foul, rip off
Nov 2022 • Solo
$22.50USD for a king box (compared to 19.50 + 1.75 upsize drink for normal meal), so thought was getting a better deal.
Have never such a big rip off of a burger king, and the food was reprehensible. i threw 50% away.
The first time the burger was a single when paid for a double. Upon remaking it they had added the onions i'd asked not to get the first time. Fairly certain had half the allotted amount of cheese too. Wow. Dripping grease, just outrageous, just gross. There goes my cortisol for the day. I guess Tokyo will now seem cheap after the worst meal of my SE Asia trip.
AVOID at all costs! I can understand some markup for an airport, but these prices are outlandish. I will never eat at BK again, one good thing to come of this!
